purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The municipal Finance Secretariat publishes a service titled “Plantas Digitalizadas”; city planning reports document the Cadastro Imobiliário and its updates. An official 2026 municipal gazette contains a development-submitted georeferenced orthophoto/planning map, which is project-specific rather than a public municipal parcel feature service. The online cadastral-plans page exposed embedded content but no public vector/API schema or WUP-point feature; no taxpayer or property identifier was entered.
registryAssessment: Feira de Santana municipal records describe its Cadastro Imobiliário and the municipal Finance Secretariat exposes a digital cadastral-plans service.
